actions.reason: K4_C0004 lacks positive evidence for independent membership. Its set-level geometry report shows near-zero or negative silhouettes and within-set distances equal to or larger than between-set distances in every modality, i.e., no geometric distinction from the rest. Its pair-level reports against K4_C0001 and K4_C0002 likewise show near-zero silhouettes and near-equal within/between distances in ct, rna, and wsi, and the K4_C0003 pair shows only weak separation. The candidate-specific confounder report leaves measured technical/acquisition factors as weak but not fully excluded alternatives (no factor survives correction; sparse categorical cells), so it does not supply positive membership support. The partition-level known-label echo is contextual only and does not establish independence. Its RNA phenotype is interpretable but biological identity alone does not establish independent retention, and no supported internal subdivision or boundary revision would repair the failure. Independence is unsupported after decision-relevant evidence is exhausted.

K4_C0001 lacks positive evidence for independent membership. Its set-level geometry report shows near-zero silhouettes in all modalities and near-equal within/between distances (wsi even slightly larger within-set), providing little geometric support for separate representation. Its pair-level reports against K4_C0004 and K4_C0002 show only weak, mostly wxs-confined separation with near-zero silhouettes in ct, rna, and wsi. The partition-level known-label echo is contextual only and does not establish independence. Its RNA phenotype (OXPHOS-down, immune-down) is interpretable, but biological identity alone does not establish independent retention, and no supported internal subdivision or boundary revision would repair the failure. Independence is unsupported after decision-relevant evidence is exhausted.

K4_C0002 lacks positive evidence for independent membership. Its set-level geometry report shows only a small within-versus-between distinction confined largely to wxs (silhouette 0.177), with little distinction in ct, rna, and wsi. Its pair-level reports against K4_C0004 show essentially no separation in ct, rna, and wsi, and against K4_C0001 and K4_C0003 only weak, single-modality-confined separation. The partition-level known-label echo is contextual only and does not establish independence. Its RNA phenotype (OXPHOS-up, lipid-metabolic) is interpretable, but biological identity alone does not establish independent retention, and no supported internal subdivision or boundary revision would repair the failure. Independence is unsupported after decision-relevant evidence is exhausted.

K4_C0003 lacks positive evidence for independent membership. Its set-level geometry report shows only small but positive silhouettes and small within-versus-between gaps across modalities, i.e., weak geometric distinction. Its pair-level reports against K4_C0004 and K4_C0002 show only weak, single-modality-confined separation with small silhouettes. The partition-level known-label echo is contextual only and does not establish independence. Its RNA phenotype (immune/inflammatory-up) is interpretable, but biological identity alone does not establish independent retention, and no supported internal subdivision or boundary revision would repair the failure. Independence is unsupported after decision-relevant evidence is exhausted.
